reply:
**Status: Referred to a claims handler**

The claim has been recorded in the Veridia claims system under reference **final-CLM-17** and escalated to a human claims handler. No settlement has been computed or staged.

**Facts recorded**
- Policy VER-1007, policyholder Emma Rousseau (presumed driver, as the email does not say anyone else was driving).
- Vehicle: Tesla Model 3 (2023), market value €32,000.
- Coverage claimed: C2 (collision damage to her own car), which is in the Policy Schedule.
- Incident on 22 October 2026. Reported 23 October 2026, one day later and within the 5-day reporting deadline.
- The car hit a tyre barrier in a corner during a track day at a racing circuit. No other party or vehicle was involved.
- Repair quote: €5,200.
- Attachments received: damage_photos.zip and repair_quote.pdf. Both are in the claim file. I have not been able to open them.

**Reasoning**
- **Possible exclusion (racing / track day):** The email describes use of the insured car at a track day at a racing circuit, and the claims system flagged "possible_exclusion: racing." Whether this is excluded depends on the contract's exclusion terms. I could not confirm the exact exclusion article in this session, so a human handler needs to review it against the contract. This is the blocking issue.
- **Timeliness:** Reported within the 5-day deadline, so there is no late-report issue.
- **Coverage:** C2 is in the Policy Schedule, so there is no coverage-not-in-schedule issue.
- **Documents:** Photos and repair quote are present, so no document request was needed.
- Because of the open exclusion question, I did not compute the settlement, schedule an assessor, or stage a payment.

**Amounts**
- Not computed. The deductible, payout and assessor requirement will be determined by the handler after the exclusion review.

**Draft message to the customer**
> Dear Ms Rousseau,
>
> Thank you for reporting the accident of 22 October 2026 under your policy VER-1007. We have received your repair quote and photos. Your claim has been referred to one of our claims handlers, who will review the circumstances of the incident, including the track-day use you described, and will contact you with the outcome.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims Team
